_about: Round 14 (2026-11-25): Google Lyria as the music model, next to the current one (ACE-Step). Same plan, same effects and same mix on every tile; only who composes the music changes. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json.

variants.label: Google Lyria 3 Pro
variants.why: Google's newest music model. It is told when each part of the story starts and writes one piece to exactly the video's length. Still a preview release at Google.
